title: Practice 3: до, после, около, мимо, кроме, вместо, против…

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: После соития всякое животное грустно, кроме ___ (женщина) и петуха.
exercises.prompt: Every animal is sad after coitus, except the woman and the rooster.
exercises.why: «кроме» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: У Тома вместо ___ (нога) протез.
exercises.why: «вместо» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Мы протестовали против ___ (снижение) зарплаты.
exercises.prompt: We protested against the reduction in wages.
exercises.why: «против» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Когда разразился скандал, среди ___ (избиратели) конгрессмена поднялась буря.
exercises.prompt: When the scandal broke, the Congressman's constituents were seething.
exercises.why: «среди» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Мэри повязала вокруг ___ (талия) фартук и достала индюшку из духовки.
exercises.prompt: Mary tied an apron around her waist and then took the turkey out of the oven.
exercises.why: «вокруг» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Жди меня возле ___ (выход).
exercises.prompt: Wait for me near the exit.
exercises.why: «возле» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Британцы атаковали из-за ___ (река).
exercises.prompt: The British started to attack from across the river.
exercises.why: «из-за» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Перископ подводной лодки выглядывал из-под ___ (вода).
exercises.prompt: The submarine's periscope was sticking out of the water.
exercises.why: «из-под» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Грабы росли вдоль ___ (шоссе).
exercises.prompt: Hornbeams were growing along the highway.
exercises.why: «вдоль» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Напротив, ___ (доктор) говорят, что есть еще надежда!
exercises.why: «напротив» + genitive. From Антон Чехов, «Дипломат».

exercises.q: She was a Bennett before she married.
exercises.why: «до» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He has woken up from his coma.
exercises.why: «после» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: There are about a thousand Papuan languages in existence.
exercises.why: «около» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The car raced past the farm.
exercises.why: «мимо» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: No plays delight me except those of Plautus.
exercises.ru: Никакие пьесы меня не восхищают, кроме ___ Плавта.
exercises.why: «кроме» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Instead of adding, I had to learn to subtract.
exercises.why: «вместо» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Chinese journalists at a major newspaper have gone on strike to protest against censorship.
exercises.ru: Журналисты крупнейшего новостного издания Китая устроили забастовку против ___.
exercises.why: «против» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Among our friends, there are Serbs and Croats and Muslims.
exercises.ru: Среди ___ есть и сербы, и хорваты, и мусульмане.
exercises.why: «среди» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The water whirled around the rocks.
exercises.why: «вокруг» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Wooden boards were carelessly dumped near the fence.
exercises.why: «возле» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
